issue_title: Let operators tag runs with free-form labels
issue_body: Operators group runs by campaign and incident by hand. Add a labels column to runs, accept labels on start, return them on every run read, and make sure a bad release of this change can be backed out quickly.

plan.summary: Add a labels column to runs through a new migration, thread it through the run queries and response, and back a failed release out automatically.

approach.description: Add migration 0104_add_run_labels: the up file adds a nullable text[] labels column to runs, and the down file drops it.
Thread labels through the run queries and the run response, and accept them on run start.
If the post-deploy health check fails, the deploy job runs the migrate CLI's down step for this release's migrations against the production database, then redeploys the previous image.
Add tests: the migration applies and drops cleanly on the test database, and the run response carries labels.

verification.test_strategy: Migration tests on the shared test Postgres plus handler tests for labels on start and read; a script test that a failing health check triggers the back-out path.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A run started with labels returns the same labels on every run read.
A release whose post-deploy check fails is backed out without operator action.

defect_phrases: down step for this release's migrations

catching_examples.note: Step 3 runs the migrate CLI's down step against the production database. ADR-006 (applies to backend/internal/db/migrations/**) makes production rollback forward-only: down files are for local dev, and a bad schema change is undone by a revert migration. Replace the back-out with a revert migration.
Running down migrations against the production database conflicts with ADR-006; production schema changes roll forward.
Step 3: production rollback under ADR-006 is forward-only, not a down migration.

non_catching_examples.note: Step 3: the back-out trigger is unjustified.
Step 3 redeploys the previous image from the deploy job; ADR-073 makes the Helm chart the single deployment substrate, so confirm the job goes through the chart.
ac-labels-returned does not cap how many labels a run may carry.
The down step in step 3 has no test of its own in scope.
